layers.text: Recolour only: the red tents become dull tan hide tents (#9b8461, shadows #5b4b36) with darker stitched patches; the pale grey hut becomes rusted iron sheets (#8a4a2a) and dull gunmetal scrap; the red flag cloth on the lookout pole is removed, but the tall lookout pole and its small basket platform stay, in dark gunmetal iron; no red left. Keep every building's shape and place, the size, black outline and art style exactly the same.
